title: Hayati Pro Max Lemon & Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Lemon and Mint brings together citrus sweetness and minty freshness cool in a uniquely refreshing blend. Bright Lemon delivers a lively citrus kick, while crisp Mint follows through with a smooth, cooling note that complements rather than overwhelms. The two flavours work in harmony to create a clean and revitalising vape that’s perfect for hot days or a fresh all-day vape. Formulated with nicotine salts for a softer throat hit and faster nicotine delivery, this e-liquid is best enjoyed in MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG ratio offers dependable flavour and discreet vapour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
